criteria.description: Workbook opens and exposes identifiable receipt identity, item, category, reconciliation, and source-traceability sections.
Each supplied receipt is represented once with the correct merchant, date, and source filename, independent of row order or candidate-assigned document ID.
Each receipt item is represented once with the correct source receipt, description, modifier, amount, and category.
Document and item IDs/linkage are non-empty, unique where required, and complete without duplicate source items.
Each document subtotal, tax, tip, and total agrees with the receipt-grounded amount, whether values are static or formula-linked.
Document totals, category totals, and the batch reconciliation agree with one another and with the supplied receipts.
Category-summary values agree with the receipt-grounded category totals independent of formula use or row order.
Each item links once to the correct receipt image with a candidate-readable locator; no private locator token is required.
Reconciliation document count, item count, and batch total evaluate correctly, whether static or formula-linked.
Penalty for provenance that cites a receipt filename outside the supplied sources.
